title: Suppressing @grafana/no-config-feature-toggles lint errors
answers: How do I fix a @grafana/no-config-feature-toggles lint failure blocking CI?
CI lint fails on new file using old-style config feature toggles
How to unblock main when a new usage of the legacy feature toggle API trips the eslint rule
eslint-suppressions.json count mismatch for feature toggles
body:
Symptom: CI/lint fails with '@grafana/no-config-feature-toggles' on a file that reads feature toggles via the old config-based API instead of OpenFeature.
Root cause: the file introduces/uses a call site of the legacy toggle API (e.g. public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/VizPanelSubHeader.tsx) that isn't yet migrated to OpenFeature, and isn't listed in the suppressions allowlist.
Fix pattern: add (or bump) an entry in eslint-suppressions.json keyed by the exact file path with the rule name and a 'count' equal to the number of flagged occurrences in that file; this is an intentional, temporary unblock, not a real fix - the underlying call sites still need OpenFeature migration later.
Constraints: only use this to unblock CI while migration is pending; the count must exactly match the number of violations in the file or lint will fail again (too low) or silently allow new violations (too high, if not reviewed).
applies: Any PR touching public/app files that trips eslint-suppressions.json-tracked rules, especially @grafana/no-config-feature-toggles during the OpenFeature migration.
